# Real mixed-track stem fixture

Six-second excerpt of **The Easton Ellises – Falcon 69**, distributed with
`stempeg`/MUSDB for source-separation tests. The track is licensed
CC BY-NC-SA 3.0.

Source container: `stempeg/data/The Easton Ellises - Falcon 69.stem.mp4`
Source project: https://github.com/faroit/stempeg
Dataset information: https://sigsep.github.io/datasets/musdb.html

`mixture.wav` is the only input supplied to the production separator. The four
source WAVs are opened by the test only after inference and are used solely to
score whether each inferred output contains the corresponding real source.
